made_from: lily_generator.blend, object Lily (Lily Generator geometry nodes), frame 200 (build-up finished), exported 2026-11-13
shape_keys: Morph targets 0..8 = the whole flower with Petal Arc Bend at arc_values[i] (0 = -0.90 ... 8 = +1.66). The base mesh equals target 0. Everything else stays as in settings.

attributes._petal_u: 0 at the petal base -> 1 at the tip (petals only)
attributes._petal_v: -1 .. 1 across the petal width, 0 = middle (petals only)
attributes._part: material slot: 1 petal, 2 stamen, 3 stem, 4 anther, 5 leaf

axes: Y-up (converted from Blender Z-up by the glTF exporter). Units = Blender units.
notes: COLOR_0 holds the petal colour on the petal mesh; on stamen, stem, anther and leaf it is plain white (use their material colour).
All materials are exported with alphaMode BLEND from Blender; for the web look it is better to replace them with your own materials.
To animate opening/closing: blend between neighbouring morph targets (e.g. set influence of target i to 1-f and i+1 to f). Target 0 = most closed (-0.90), target 8 = most open (+1.66).
